features.name: Business Central MCP Server
features.description: A Model Context Protocol server implementation for Business Central that allows standardized connection between AI models and Business Central data sources. Enables tools exposure for creating orders and reading system information.
caveats: Only tools are currently supported in Copilot Studio, not resources
Resources support is being worked on for future versions

features.name: MCP Resources Component
features.description: MCP protocol component for exposing resources such as documents. Microsoft is working on adding resources support to Business Central MCP server in Copilot Studio.
caveats: Not yet available in Copilot Studio

features.name: MCP Tools Component
features.description: MCP protocol component that allows exposure of tools to perform actions on data sources such as creating orders or reading system information. Currently the only supported component for Business Central in Copilot Studio.

features.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
features.description: An open standard protocol created by Anthropic that standardizes connectivity between AI models and multiple data sources using a single protocol rather than requiring custom integration for each source. Acts as a universal connector similar to USB.

features.name: MCP Prompts Component
features.description: MCP protocol component for reusing different prompts in LLM solutions. Part of the standard MCP protocol but not heavily utilized.

features.name: MCP Sampling, Elicitation and Apps
features.description: Newer MCP protocol components for creating apps and user input directly in MCPs. Not widely adopted yet.
caveats: Not widely used in current solutions

features.name: MCP Server Standard for Business Central
features.description: A standardized protocol to open Business Central entities externally for creating agents and providing business value through model context protocol.
features.status_evidence_quote: The MCP server standard uh is in public preview from 27.1
caveats: Only tools supported in Copilot Studio, not resources yet

features.name: MCP Server Proxy
features.description: An experimental MCP server option for use with cloud environments, not officially supported by Microsoft.
features.status_evidence_quote: This is very important. Experimental. If you want to use the MCP server with cloud up to you, but it's experimental. It's not supported

features.name: MCP Server for Administration
features.description: An MCP server component for managing environments, applications, and apps within your Business Central environment.

features.name: Dynamic Tool Configuration
features.description: A configuration mode that exposes three standard tools (search, describe, invoke) without explicitly adding API pages, allowing LLM to dynamically select the best API.
caveats: Limited to three tools: search, describe, invoke

features.name: Static Configuration Mode
features.description: A configuration approach needed for write scenarios to explicitly specify which APIs and actions should be exposed for create, update, and delete operations.
caveats: Requires manual permission configuration for each API

features.name: MCP Default Read-Only Access
features.description: The default MCP server configuration provides read-only access to Business Central data. Write operations require explicit configuration with appropriate permissions per table and action.
caveats: Write permissions must be explicitly granted

features.name: MCP Server Connection in Copilot Studio
features.description: Copilot Studio can integrate MCP servers for Business Central by selecting the MCP server configuration, specifying environment, MCP server configuration, and company. This enables AI agents to access Business Central data.
caveats: Requires selection of MCP server configuration

features.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Discovery in Copilot Studio
features.description: Copilot Studio tool management allows users to discover and add available Model Context Protocol implementations, including the Business Central MCP server, from a centralized catalog.

features.name: MCP Tool Search, Describe, and Invoke Actions
features.description: The MCP server exposes three core actions through Copilot Studio: search to find data, describe to get metadata about objects, and invoke to perform operations. These tools refresh based on the selected MCP configuration.
caveats: Can be disabled to avoid confusion

features.name: Copilot Agent Query Execution Against Business Central
features.description: Copilot agents can execute natural language queries against Business Central via the MCP server, retrieving customer lists and other data directly from the specified company and environment.
caveats: Limited to read operations by default

features.name: AI-Generated Visualizations in Copilot Studio
features.description: Copilot Studio can create pie charts and Excel files based on Business Central data retrieved through the MCP server, enabling agents to generate formatted visualizations and reports.

features.name: MCP Read-Only Constraint for Write Operations
features.description: The MCP server with default or read-only configuration cannot execute write operations such as creating sales orders. Create, modify, and delete operations are not available in read-only mode.

features.name: MCP Native AI Tool Design
features.description: The MCP is designed specifically as a native AI tool, distinguishing it from other Business Central connectors which are not optimized for AI operations.

features.name: Validate feature for API exposure
features.description: Validate is a new feature that allows deciding which related entities to expose when exposing sales lines, such as header data, ensuring complete information is available.

features.name: Connection string configuration
features.description: A new feature allowing users to copy and reuse the MCP connection string across different customers, solutions, and cloud environments beyond just Copilot Studio.

features.name: MCP integration with VS Code
features.description: The MCP can be configured in VS Code using mcp.json file to query Business Central data, such as item lists, directly from the development environment.

features.name: Query exposure in MCP
features.description: New capability to expose queries through MCP server configuration, allowing AI tools to access custom and standard queries from Business Central.

features.name: Page and API selection for exposure
features.description: Users can choose which pages and APIs to expose through the MCP, including both standard and custom APIs from Business Central.

features.name: Configuration export and import
features.description: New buttons allow exporting MCP configuration from sandbox environments and importing it to production, streamlining deployment processes.

features.name: Copilot Studio tool selections
features.description: New tool selections from Copilot Studio that are being created by Microsoft for use with the MCP. These are not yet public and not available in all environments, but can be used.

features.name: Power BI integration with MCP agents
features.description: Agents can obtain information and pass it to Power BI through the MCP server, enabling data visualization capabilities for agents.

features.name: Custom APIs for custom fields
features.description: When custom fields are added to Business Central, custom APIs must be exposed to allow agents to learn about and access these fields. Tool tips and captions in the APIs provide context for the agent.
caveats: needs proper documentation in tool tips and captions
